jobs.description:
In dieser Funktion bist du als Technischer Spezialist Produktion TSP (m/w/d) ein zentraler Bestandteil unseres Support-Teams in der Elektronikfertigung.

Du stellst die Anlagenverfügbarkeit durch vorbeugende Wartung sicher, minimierst Stillstände durch nachhaltige Instandhaltungsstrategien und behebst Störungen inklusive Ursachenanalyse. Dabei treibst du kontinuierliche Verbesserungen im Bereich Maintenance voran und entwickelst deine Fachkenntnisse (z. B. im TPS) stetig weiter.

Als technische Schnittstelle zwischen Produktion, Engineering und Entwicklung unterstützt du die Fachbereiche, berätst bei technischen Fragestellungen und wirkst an der Optimierung unserer Anlagen mit.

Mehr über die Rolle

• Sicherstellung der Anlagenverfügbarkeit durch vorbeugende Wartung von Anlagen, Betriebs- und Prüfmitteln

• Minimierung von Stillständen durch nachhaltige Instandhaltungsstrategien und Unterstützung der Maschinenbediener bei grundlegenden Wartungsaufgaben

• Analyse und Behebung von Störungen in der Produktion inklusive Ursachenanalyse

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung (Continuous Improvement) im Bereich Maintenance

• Technische Schnittstelle zwischen Produktion, Engineering, Entwicklung sowie weiteren Fachbereichen (R&D, NPI, B&I)

• Technische Beratung und Unterstützung der Produktionsabteilungen sowie Mitwirkung bei der Optimierung von Anlagen

• Koordination, Dokumentation und Überwachung von Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen (inkl. LEXA) sowie Einhaltung von Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsvorschriften

• Verwaltung und Beschaffung von Ersatzteilen sowie Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung automatisierter Anlagen und Pikettdienst bei Bedarf

Mehr über dich

• Abgeschlossene technische Berufsbildung (EFZ) im elektronischen Bereich (z. B. Automatiker, Polymechaniker, Elektroniker)

• Erfahrung in der Elektronikproduktion, idealerweise mit Kenntnissen in Lean Management, Supply Chain und SMD/Flip-Chip-Bestückung

• Gute Übersicht über die gesamte Produktionskette sowie idealerweise Erfahrung in der Automatisierung oder Halbleiterfertigung

• Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis, schnelle Auffassungsgabe und bereichsübergreifendes Denken

• Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie strukturierte und verantwortungsvolle Arbeitsweise

• Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Schulungen sowie in der Einhaltung von Prozessen und Qualitätsstandards

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Gute PC-Anwenderkenntnisse (MS Office 365); SAP-Kenntnisse von Vorteil

Als eines der weltweit führenden Unternehmen im Bereich Hörlösungen mit Hauptsitz in der Schweiz legen wir großen Wert auf eine inklusive und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur.

Description

In this role, you are a central part of our support team in electronics manufacturing as a Technical Production Specialist TSP (m/f/d).

You ensure equipment availability through preventive maintenance, minimize downtime through sustainable maintenance strategies, and resolve malfunctions, including root cause analysis. In doing so, you drive continuous improvements in Maintenance and continuously develop your technical expertise (e.g., in TPS).

As a technical interface between production, engineering, and development, you support the specialist departments, advise on technical issues, and contribute to optimizing our systems.

More about the role

- Ensuring equipment availability through preventive maintenance of equipment, operating resources and testing equipment
- Minimizing downtime through sustainable maintenance strategies and supporting machine operators with basic maintenance tasks
- Analysis and resolution of disruptions in production, including root cause analysis
- Continuous Improvement (Continuous Improvement) in the Maintenance area
- Technical interface between Production, Engineering, Development, and other specialist departments (R&D, NPI, B&I)
- Technical consulting and support for the production departments, as well as involvement in the optimization of equipment
- Coordination, documentation and monitoring of maintenance activities (including LEXA) as well as compliance with quality and safety regulations
- Management and procurement of spare parts, as well as support in the further development of automated systems and on-call service as needed

More about you

- Completed technical vocational training (EFZ) in the electronic field (e.g. automation technician, polymechanic, electronics technician)
- Experience in electronics production, ideally with knowledge of lean management, supply chain and SMD/flip-chip assembly
- Good overview of the entire production chain and, ideally, experience in automation or semiconductor manufacturing
- Strong technical understanding, quick comprehension and cross-departmental thinking
- High quality awareness as well as structured and responsible way of working
- Experience in conducting training courses as well as in adhering to processes and quality standards
- Very good knowledge of German as well as good written and spoken English skills
- Good PC user skills (MS Office 365); SAP knowledge is an advantage

More about our offer

As one of the world's leading hearing solutions companies headquartered in Switzerland, we attach great importance to an inclusive and appreciative corporate culture.

We offer you:

- Structured induction as well as targeted internal and external training
- Individual development and growth opportunities
- A modern production environment with short decision-making processes
- The opportunity to take responsibility and actively shape processes

jobs.title: Power Management Engineer (80%-100%) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Research & Development delivers hearing solutions and services for people with hearing loss, hearing care professionals, and further related people, in the form of hearing instruments, accessories, web services, mobile applications, and PC software.

As a Power Management Engineer, you will hold a pivotal role in enabling the industry‑leading AI hearing functions that define our next‑generation products. You are the one who ensures that cutting‑edge intelligence is not only possible, but reliably powered every moment. This position sits at the crossroads of multiple technical domains: electronic design, battery innovation, and embedded software, offering a uniquely dynamic environment where your decisions directly shape performance, efficiency, and user experience. It is a role for someone who wants to be at the technological core, driving the energy systems that make advanced hearing AI truly come alive.

.

More about the role

• Design, develop, and optimize battery and power management systems for hearing instruments and charging solutions

• Specify, integrate, and validate power management circuits for rechargeable and non-rechargeable battery systems

• Evaluate, specify, integrate, and optimize Power Management ICs (PMICs) and related power conversion architectures for future hearing instruments and charging systems

• Define and implement battery management algorithms and power strategies, including State of Charge and State of Health estimation, charging behavior, protection mechanisms, and energy optimization

• Collaborate closely with hardware and firmware teams to ensure robust integration of battery and power management functions into the overall hearing instrument and charger architecture

• Develop and validate electrical and system-level models for power consumption, load profiles, and battery behavior under different operating conditions

• Analyze and debug complex power-related system issues, driving root-cause identification and resolution

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of power management platforms, methods, and development processes, and stay informed about emerging technologies and trends

• Evaluate emerging power management technologies and energy management concepts to support future product generations

More about you

• Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Microelectronics, or a related field

• Proven experience in the design of power management systems for low-power embedded devices, including DC/DC conversion, load switches, charging circuits, and energy-efficient architectures

• Experience with rechargeable and non-rechargeable battery technologies, as well as a strong understanding of system-level behavior, load profiling, power consumption analysis, and battery aging effects

• Hands-on experience with electrical characterization, laboratory measurements, and data-driven validation of power systems

• Strong programming skills in Python for data analysis, automation, and model development; MATLAB is a plus

• Experience in optimizing ultra-low-power systems under strict energy and size constraints is an asset

• Experience in debugging complex power-related issues in low-power applications and charging systems is an asset

• Structured, proactive, and quality-conscious working style, with the ability to bring forward innovative ideas and collaborate effectively in a distributed, diverse environment

• Fluent in English (spoken and written)

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

Employment level 80-100%.

Application process

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your complete application (cover letter, CV, references, and certificates) via our online job application platform.

For this vacancy only direct applications will be considered.

In qualità di Power Management Engineer, ricoprirai un ruolo fondamentale nel consentire alle funzioni uditive AI leader del settore che definiscono i nostri prodotti di nuova generazione. Tu sei quello che assicura che l'intelligenza all'avanguardia non è solo possibile, ma affidabile ogni momento. Questa posizione si trova all'incrocio di più domini tecnici: design elettronico, innovazione della batteria e software incorporato, offrendo un ambiente unico e dinamico in cui le vostre decisioni modellano direttamente le prestazioni, l'efficienza e l'esperienza dell'utente. È un ruolo per qualcuno che vuole essere al centro tecnologico, guidando i sistemi energetici che rendono l'intelligenza artificiale uditiva avanzata veramente vivo.

.

Ulteriori informazioni sul ruolo

• Progettazione, sviluppo e ottimizzazione dei sistemi di gestione della batteria e della potenza per strumenti acustici e soluzioni di ricarica

• Specificare, integrare e convalidare i circuiti di gestione della potenza per i sistemi di batteria ricaricabili e non ricaricabili

• Valutare, specificare, integrare e ottimizzare gli IC di Power Management (PMIC) e le relative architetture di conversione di potenza per futuri strumenti acustici e sistemi di ricarica

• Definire e implementare algoritmi di gestione della batteria e strategie di potenza, tra cui la stima di stato di carica e stato di salute, il comportamento di ricarica, i meccanismi di protezione e l'ottimizzazione dell'energia

• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team hardware e firmware per garantire una solida integrazione delle funzioni di gestione della batteria e dell'alimentazione nell'architettura globale dello strumento acustico e del caricabatterie

• Sviluppare e convalidare modelli elettrici e di livello di sistema per il consumo di energia, profili di carico e comportamento della batteria in diverse condizioni operative

• Analizzare e debug complessi problemi di sistema legati alla potenza, guidando l'identificazione e la risoluzione di root-cause

• Contribuire al miglioramento continuo delle piattaforme, dei metodi e dei processi di sviluppo di power management e rimanere informato sulle tecnologie e tendenze emergenti

• Valutare le tecnologie emergenti di gestione del potere e i concetti di gestione dell'energia per supportare le future generazioni di prodotti

Più di te

• Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Ingegneria Elettrica/Elettrica, Microelettronica o un campo correlato

• Esperienza dimostrata nella progettazione di sistemi di gestione della potenza per dispositivi incorporati a bassa potenza, tra cui conversione DC/DC, interruttori di carico, circuiti di ricarica e architetture ad alta efficienza energetica

• Esperienza con tecnologie di batteria ricaricabili e non ricaricabili, nonché una forte comprensione del comportamento a livello di sistema, della profilazione del carico, dell'analisi del consumo di energia e degli effetti di invecchiamento della batteria

• Esperienza pratica con caratterizzazione elettrica, misurazioni di laboratorio e validazione dei sistemi di alimentazione

• Forte capacità di programmazione in Python per l'analisi dei dati, l'automazione e lo sviluppo dei modelli; MATLAB è un plus

• L'esperienza nell'ottimizzazione dei sistemi ultra-bassi sotto rigidi vincoli di energia e dimensione è un bene

• L'esperienza nel debugging di problemi energetici complessi in applicazioni a bassa potenza e sistemi di ricarica è un bene

• Stile di lavoro strutturato, proattivo e di qualità consapevole, con la capacità di portare avanti idee innovative e collaborare efficacemente in un ambiente distribuito e diversificato

• Fluente in inglese (spoken e scritto)

Maggiori informazioni su ciò che offriamo

Come uno dei principali fornitori di servizi per l’udito con sede in Svizzera, ci impegniamo a costruire una cultura inclusiva. Vogliamo creare un ambiente in cui è possibile bilanciare una carriera di successo con i vostri impegni e interessi al di fuori del lavoro, attraverso il nostro modello di lavoro ibrido flessibile. Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di formazione sia per il vostro sviluppo professionale che personale, e ci sono eccezionali opportunità di crescita con i piani di sviluppo individuali.

Livello di occupazione 80-100%.

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, non vede l'ora di ricevere l'applicazione completa (lettera di copertura, CV, riferimenti e certificati) tramite la nostra piattaforma di applicazione del lavoro online.

Diese Position steht an der Kreuzung mehrerer technischer Bereiche: Elektronikdesign, Batterieinnovation und eingebettete Software und bietet eine einzigartig dynamische Umgebung, in der Ihre Entscheidungen Leistung, Effizienz und Benutzererfahrung direkt beeinflussen. Es ist eine Rolle für jemanden, der im technologischen Kern sein möchte und die Energiesysteme antreibt, die fortschrittliche Hörgeräte wirklich zum Leben erwecken.

.

Mehr über die Rolle

• Design, Entwicklung und Optimierung von Batterie- und Power-Management-Systemen für Hörgeräte und Ladelösungen

• Spezifizierung, Integration und Validierung von Strommanagementschaltungen für wiederaufladbare und nicht wiederaufladbare Batteriesysteme

• Evaluieren, spezifizieren, integrieren und optimieren Sie Power-Management-ICs (PMICs) und verwandte Stromwandlungsarchitekturen für zukünftige Hörgeräte und Ladesysteme

• Definieren und implementieren Sie Batteriemanagementalgorithmen und Energiestrategien, einschließlich Ladezustand und Gesundheitszustandsschätzung, Ladeverhalten, Schutzmechanismen und Energieoptimierung

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Hardware- und Firmware-Teams, um eine robuste Integration von Batterie- und Power-Management-Funktionen in die gesamte Hörinstrument- und Ladegerätearchitektur sicherzustellen

• Entwicklung und Validierung elektrischer und systembasierter Modelle für Stromverbrauch, Lastprofile und Batterieverhalten unter verschiedenen Betriebsbedingungen

• Analysieren und Debuggen von komplexen energiebezogenen Systemproblemen, Antreiben von Root-Ursache-Identifikation und -Auflösung

• Tragen Sie zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Power-Management-Plattformen, -Methoden und -Entwicklungsprozessen bei und informieren Sie sich über neue Technologien und Trends

• Bewertung neuer Energiemanagement-Technologien und Energiemanagement-Konzepte zur Unterstützung zukünftiger Produktgenerationen

Mehr über dich

• Master-Abschluss oder PhD in Elektrotechnik, Mikroelektronik oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Bewährte Erfahrung im Design von Energiemanagementsystemen für eingebettete Geräte mit geringem Stromverbrauch, einschließlich DC/DC-Konvertierung, Lastschaltern, Ladeschaltungen und energieeffizienten Architekturen

• Erfahrung mit wiederaufladbaren und nicht wiederaufladbaren Batterietechnologien sowie ein fundiertes Verständnis des Verhaltens auf Systemebene, der Lastprofilierung, der Stromverbrauchsanalyse und der Batteriealterungseffekte

• Praxiserfahrung mit elektrischer Charakterisierung, Labormessungen und datengesteuerter Validierung von Stromsystemen

• Starke Programmierkenntnisse in Python für Datenanalyse, Automatisierung und Modellentwicklung; MATLAB ist ein Plus

• Erfahrung in der Optimierung von Ultra-Low-Power-Systemen unter strengen Energie- und Größenbeschränkungen ist eine Bereicherung

• Erfahrung im Debuggen komplexer energiebezogener Probleme in Low-Power-Anwendungen und Ladesystemen ist eine Bereicherung

• Fließend in Englisch (gesprochen und geschrieben)

jobs.description:
At Sonova R&D, we are not just developing hearing devices, we are shaping the future of hearing technology. At the heart of this transformation is the deployment and execution of neural networks on our next-generation embedded platform. This requires innovative tools and firmware infrastructure, giving you the opportunity to directly influence the performance of our products.

As our new Software Engineer Embedded AI you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI and ultra-low-power embedded systems. You will develop the embedded AI software stack that forms the foundation of our next-generation hearing instruments.

Are you excited to explore new technological territory and play a pivotal role in shaping Sonova’s edge AI capabilities? Join us and help rethink how embedded software is built to enhance people’s hearing experience and quality of life.

More about the role

• Develop firmware for a deeply embedded AI platform operating under strict latency, memory, compute, and energy constraints

• Design, implement, and maintain the embedded AI software stack including optimization for performance, latency, and energy efficiency

• Collaborate with AI and DSP experts to analyze and deploy DNN algorithms in hearing-device applications

• Tailor AI algorithms to the embedded platform and its constraints (e.g., quantization, memory, compute and power)

• Implement prototypes, bring them to production-ready features and integrate them into our system in collaboration with other engineering teams.

• Ensure high software quality through clean-code practices, code reviews, testing, documentation, maintenance, and root-cause analysis

• Continuously improve development methodologies, tools, design patterns, and best practices for efficient ML/DNN development and deployment

More about you

• Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field

• Strong hands-on experience with embedded C++, Python, and object-oriented programming

• Experience developing and deploying neural networks on embedded systems, including familiarity with deployment frameworks such as TensorFlow Lite, ONNX, TVM, or ExecuTorch

• Knowledge of embedded compilers, micro-NPUs, and system-level simulation

• Experience with CUDA is an advantage

• Knowledge of audio or digital signal processing is an advantage

• Experience in bringing features to products is an advantage

• Fluent English, with strong written and verbal communication skills

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

jobs.description:
About the role

We are looking to hire a Director of NPI & Lifecycle Governance to join our Global Supply Chain organization.

Reporting to the VP of Supply Chain, this is a global, highly cross-functional role responsible for the end-to-end governance of New Product Introduction (NPI) and product lifecycle transitions, from launch readiness, ramp-up and phase-out. The role connects with R&D, Regulatory, Quality, Commercial, Finance, Operations and Supply Chain to ensure that product launches are operationally ready and that risks, dependencies and decisions are addressed at the right time in within the Operations team.

This is also an opportunity to help shape and further develop how we manage NPI and lifecycle governance globally. The organization and operating model continue to evolve, so we are looking for someone who is comfortable building and improving processes while operating in a dynamic environment.

The role is based in our HQ in Stäfa, Switzerland and requires international collaboration across functions, regions and manufacturing sites (30 % travel expected).

Key responsibilities

• Lead launch-readiness governance, bringing together the relevant functions to provide a clear, fact-based view of whether the organization is ready to launch.

• Ensure operational readiness across manufacturing, suppliers, materials, capacity, demand and supply planning, logistics, service, master data and market deployment.

• Coordinate and challenge cross-functional launch plans, identify risks and dependencies, and ensure that the right stakeholders make the necessary decisions at the right time.

• Drive effective lifecycle transitions, including phase-in and phase-out planning, cannibalisation assumptions, last-time buys, inventory run-down, obsolescence and service/spare-parts considerations.

• Use data and analysis to challenge assumptions, highlight inconsistencies and provide clear recommendations and options to senior decision-makers.

• Own and continuously improve the launch scorecard and portfolio readiness view, providing transparency on readiness, risks, actions and key decisions across the NPI portfolio.

• Drive continuous improvement through post-launch reviews, lessons learned and stronger, more consistent ways of working across the organization.

About you

To succeed in this role, you combine strong experience in NPI, product launches, lifecycle management, supply chain or operations with the ability to connect multiple functions and turn complex information into clear actions and decisions.

You are comfortable leading through influence rather than authority. You know when to challenge assumptions, how to identify the questions that need answering, and how to bring the right people together to move decisions forward.

Given the global nature of the role, you bring strong executive presence and credibility with senior stakeholders, while being equally comfortable engaging with teams at all levels of the organization. You are able to translate complex technical and operational topics into clear business language and are comfortable working in an evolving environment where processes and ways of working are still being shaped.

Ideally, you bring:

• 8+ years of relevant experience across NPI, launch excellence, product lifecycle management, manufacturing, supply chain, operations or complex cross-functional program leadership.

• Proven experience coordinating complex product launches and working across multiple functions, regions and/or manufacturing sites.

• Strong knowledge of phase-gate governance and launch readiness, with an understanding of manufacturing and supplier readiness, demand/supply/capacity planning, lifecycle transitions and inventory risk.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to use data to challenge assumptions, assess risks and support fact-based decision-making.

• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with demonstrated ability to create alignment and accountability.

• Experience operating in a global, matrix organization; experience in medical devices, life sciences or another regulated and complex product environment is an advantage.

• A hands-on, pragmatic approach and the ability to build and improve governance, processes and ways of working in an evolving environment.

• A university degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management or a related field. Formal project, programme or process-management training is expected; PMP, PRINCE2, Lean Six Sigma or APICS/ASCM certification is an advantage.

• Fluent in English. German or additional languages are an advantage.

What we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni sul ruolo

Stiamo cercando di assumere un Direttore di NPI & Lifecycle Governance per aderire alla nostra organizzazione Global Supply Chain.

Segnalando al VP di Supply Chain, questo è un ruolo globale, altamente interfunzionale responsabile della governance end-to-end di New Product Introduzione (NPI) e delle transizioni del ciclo di vita del prodotto, dalla disponibilità di lancio, ramp-up e phase-out. Il ruolo si collega con R&D, Regolazione, Qualità, Commerciale, Finanza, Operazioni e Supply Chain per garantire che i lancio del prodotto siano pronti in modo operativo e che rischi, dipendenze e decisioni siano affrontate nel momento giusto all'interno del team Operazioni.

Questa è anche un'opportunità per contribuire a modellare e sviluppare ulteriormente come gestiamo NPI e la governance del ciclo di vita a livello globale. L'organizzazione e il modello operativo continuano ad evolversi, quindi stiamo cercando qualcuno che sia comodo costruire e migliorare i processi mentre si opera in un ambiente dinamico.

Il ruolo è basato nel nostro quartier generale di Stäfa, Svizzera e richiede la collaborazione internazionale tra funzioni, regioni e siti produttivi (30 % di viaggio previsto).

Responsabilità chiave

• Lead launch-readiness governance, che riunisce le funzioni pertinenti per fornire una chiara, visione basata sul fatto se l'organizzazione è pronta per il lancio.

• Assicurare la disponibilità operativa tra produzione, fornitori, materiali, capacità, pianificazione della domanda e dell'offerta, logistica, servizio, dati master e distribuzione del mercato.

• Coordinare e sfidare i piani di lancio interfunzionali, identificare i rischi e le dipendenze, e garantire che gli stakeholder giusti prendano le decisioni necessarie al momento giusto.

• Guidare transizioni del ciclo di vita efficaci, tra cui la pianificazione phase-in e phase-out, presupposti di cannibalizzazione, acquisti di ultima generazione, inventario run-down, obsolescenza e servizi/spare-parts considerazioni.

• Utilizzare dati e analisi per sfidare i presupposti, evidenziare le incongruenze e fornire chiare raccomandazioni e opzioni ai decisori senior.

• Migliorare costantemente la scheda di lancio e la visualizzazione della disponibilità del portafoglio, fornendo trasparenza sulla disponibilità, i rischi, le azioni e le decisioni chiave nel portafoglio NPI.

• Guidare il miglioramento continuo attraverso recensioni post-lancio, lezioni apprese e più forti, modi più coerenti di lavorare in tutta l'organizzazione.

Su di te

Per avere successo in questo ruolo, combini una forte esperienza in NPI, lanci di prodotto, gestione del ciclo di vita, supply chain o operazioni con la capacità di collegare più funzioni e trasformare le informazioni complesse in azioni e decisioni chiare.

Lei è comodo che conduce attraverso l'influenza piuttosto che l'autorità. Sai quando sfidare i presupposti, come identificare le domande che hanno bisogno di rispondere, e come riunire le persone giuste per spostare le decisioni in avanti.

Data la natura globale del ruolo, si porta una forte presenza e credibilità esecutivo con gli stakeholder senior, pur essendo altrettanto comodo impegnarsi con i team a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione. Siete in grado di tradurre argomenti tecnici e operativi complessi in un linguaggio aziendale chiaro e siete comodi a lavorare in un ambiente in evoluzione in cui processi e modi di lavoro sono ancora in fase di elaborazione.

Idealmente, si porta:

• 8+ anni di esperienza rilevante in NPI, lancio di eccellenza, gestione del ciclo di vita del prodotto, produzione, catena di fornitura, operazioni o leadership di programma multifunzionale complessa.

• Esperienza comprovata che coordina i lanci di prodotti complessi e lavora su più funzioni, regioni e/o siti di produzione.

• Forte conoscenza della governance delle porte di fase e della disponibilità di lancio, con una comprensione della prontezza di produzione e dei fornitori, della pianificazione della domanda/offerta/capacità, delle transizioni del ciclo di vita e del rischio di inventario.

• Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving, con la capacità di utilizzare i dati per sfidare i presupposti, valutare i rischi e sostenere il processo decisionale basato sul fatto.

• Forte gestione degli stakeholder e capacità di influenzare, con la capacità dimostrata di creare allineamento e responsabilità.

• Esperienza che opera in un'organizzazione globale matrice; esperienza in dispositivi medici, scienze della vita o un altro ambiente di prodotto regolamentato e complesso è un vantaggio.

• Un approccio pratico e pragmatico e la capacità di costruire e migliorare la governance, i processi e i modi di lavorare in un ambiente in evoluzione.

• Una laurea in Supply Chain, Ingegneria, Business Administration, Gestione Operazioni o un campo relativo. Si prevede un progetto formale, un programma o una formazione di gestione del processo; la certificazione PMP, PRINCE2, Lean Six Sigma o APICS/ASCM è un vantaggio.

• Fluente in inglese. Le lingue tedesche o aggiuntive sono un vantaggio.

Cosa offriamo

Come uno dei principali fornitori di servizi per l’udito con sede in Svizzera, ci impegniamo a costruire una cultura inclusiva. Vogliamo creare un ambiente in cui è possibile bilanciare una carriera di successo con i vostri impegni e interessi al di fuori del lavoro, attraverso il nostro modello di lavoro ibrido flessibile. Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di formazione sia per il vostro sviluppo professionale che personale, e ci sono eccezionali opportunità di crescita con i piani di sviluppo individuali.

Sur le rôle

Nous cherchons à embaucher un directeur de NPI & Lifecycle Governance pour rejoindre notre organisation de la chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale.

Rendre compte au vice-président de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, il s'agit d'un rôle mondial hautement interfonctionnel responsable de la gouvernance de bout en bout de l'introduction de nouveaux produits (INP) et des transitions du cycle de vie des produits, de la préparation au lancement, de la montée en puissance et de l'élimination progressive. Le rôle est lié à la R-D, à la réglementation, à la qualité, au commerce, aux finances, aux opérations et à la chaîne d'approvisionnement pour s'assurer que les lancements de produits sont prêts sur le plan opérationnel et que les risques, les dépendances et les décisions sont pris en compte au bon moment au sein de l'équipe des opérations.

C'est aussi l'occasion d'aider à façonner et à développer la façon dont nous gérons l'IPN et la gouvernance du cycle de vie à l'échelle mondiale. L'organisation et le modèle opérationnel continuent d'évoluer, donc nous cherchons quelqu'un qui est à l'aise pour construire et améliorer les processus tout en opérant dans un environnement dynamique.

Le rôle est basé dans notre QG à Stäfa, en Suisse et nécessite une collaboration internationale entre les fonctions, les régions et les sites manufacturiers (30 % de voyages attendus).

Principales responsabilités

• Diriger la gouvernance axée sur la préparation au lancement, en réunissant les fonctions pertinentes afin de fournir une vision claire et factuelle de la question de savoir si l'organisation est prête à lancer.

• Assurer la préparation opérationnelle des fabricants, des fournisseurs, des matériaux, de la capacité, de la planification de la demande et de l'offre, de la logistique, des services, des données de référence et du déploiement du marché.

• Coordonner et contester les plans de lancement interfonctionnels, cerner les risques et les dépendances et veiller à ce que les bonnes parties prenantes prennent les décisions nécessaires au bon moment.

• Conduire des transitions efficaces du cycle de vie, y compris la planification de l'entrée en vigueur et de l'élimination progressive, les hypothèses de cannibalisation, les achats pour la dernière fois, l'épuisement des stocks, l'obsolescence et les considérations de service/parties de spare.

• Utiliser les données et l'analyse pour contester les hypothèses, mettre en évidence les incohérences et fournir des recommandations et des options claires aux décideurs supérieurs.

• Sa propre carte de pointage et sa vision de l'état de préparation du portefeuille sont améliorées en permanence, ce qui assure la transparence de l'état de préparation, des risques, des actions et des décisions clés dans l'ensemble du portefeuille des IPN.

• Favoriser l'amélioration continue au moyen d'examens postérieurs au lancement, de leçons apprises et de méthodes de travail plus solides et plus uniformes dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

Sur toi

Pour y parvenir, vous combinez une solide expérience en matière d'IPN, de lancement de produits, de gestion du cycle de vie, de chaîne d'approvisionnement ou d'opérations avec la capacité de connecter plusieurs fonctions et de transformer des informations complexes en actions et décisions claires.

Vous êtes à l'aise pour mener à travers l'influence plutôt que l'autorité. Vous savez quand contester les hypothèses, comment identifier les questions auxquelles il faut répondre et comment réunir les bonnes personnes pour faire avancer les décisions.

Compte tenu de la nature mondiale du rôle, vous apportez une forte présence de la direction et de la crédibilité auprès des principaux intervenants, tout en étant à l'aise avec les équipes à tous les niveaux de l'organisation. Vous êtes en mesure de traduire des sujets techniques et opérationnels complexes dans un langage commercial clair et êtes à l'aise de travailler dans un environnement en évolution où les processus et les méthodes de travail sont encore en train d'être façonnés.

Idéalement, vous apportez:

• 8 ans et plus d'expérience pertinente à l'échelle de l'IPN, lancer l'excellence, la gestion du cycle de vie des produits, la fabrication, la chaîne d'approvisionnement, les opérations ou le leadership complexe des programmes interfonctionnels.

• Expérience éprouvée en matière de coordination des lancements de produits complexes et de travail sur plusieurs fonctions, régions et/ou sites de fabrication.

• Connaissance approfondie de la gouvernance par phase et de la préparation au lancement, avec une compréhension de l'état de préparation des fabricants et des fournisseurs, de la planification de la demande/offre/capacité, des transitions du cycle de vie et du risque d'inventaire.

• De solides capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec la capacité d'utiliser les données pour contester les hypothèses, évaluer les risques et appuyer la prise de décisions fondées sur les faits.

• Une bonne gestion des intervenants et une forte influence sur les compétences, avec une capacité démontrée d'harmoniser et de rendre compte.

• L'expérience d'une organisation matricielle mondiale; l'expérience d'instruments médicaux, de sciences de la vie ou d'un autre environnement réglementé et complexe de produits est un avantage.

• Une approche pratique et pragmatique et la capacité de construire et d'améliorer la gouvernance, les processus et les façons de travailler dans un environnement en évolution.

• Diplôme universitaire en chaîne d'approvisionnement, en génie, en administration des affaires, en gestion des opérations ou dans un domaine connexe. Une formation formelle en gestion de projet, de programme ou de processus est attendue; la certification PMP, PRINCE2, Lean Six Sigma ou APICS/ASCM est un avantage.

• En anglais. L'allemand ou d'autres langues sont un avantage.

Ce que nous offrons

As a Product Cybersecurity Expert , you will play a key role in ensuring cybersecurity is embedded into the development of Sonova's connected hearing solutions—from embedded software and mobile applications to cloud-based services.

Working closely with software engineers, product teams, architects, quality, and regulatory experts, you'll help integrate security into every stage of the product development lifecycle. Rather than focusing on operational security, you'll enable engineering teams to build secure products by design, balancing innovation, usability, compliance, and customer trust.

If you have a strong software engineering background and have expanded your expertise into product cybersecurity, this is an opportunity to shape technologies that improve the lives of millions of people worldwide.

More about the role

• Integrate cybersecurity throughout the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) for connected medical devices, embedded software, mobile applications, and cloud services.

• Lead threat modeling activities, cybersecurity risk assessments, and mitigation planning together with global R&D teams.

• Partner with software engineering teams to embed security into development workflows, DevSecOps practices, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Coordinate product vulnerability management activities, including assessment, prioritization, remediation tracking, and post-market monitoring.

• Support regulatory submissions and quality processes by preparing cybersecurity documentation and evidence.

• Advise engineering, product management, quality, and regulatory teams on practical, risk-based cybersecurity decisions.

• Promote a security-first mindset by coaching teams, supporting security champions, and driving continuous improvement across R&D.

More about you

Essential

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

• 5+ years of experience in software engineering, software architecture, product development, Secure SDLC, or a comparable software development environment.

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience in product cybersecurity or application security.

• Strong understanding of Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) and how cybersecurity integrates into modern software development.

• Experience working closely with software development teams throughout the product lifecycle.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex security topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Professional working proficiency in English.

Nice to have

• Experience developing software for medical devices or other regulated industries.

• Experience with DevSecOps and security integration into CI/CD pipelines.

• Knowledge of cybersecurity standards and regulations such as IEC 81001-5-1, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, MDR, FDA, GDPR, CRA or similar frameworks.

• Security certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, GIAC, or equivalent.

• Experience with cloud security, cryptography, authentication technologies, or software supply chain security.

• Familiarity with Privacy by Design principles, AI agent security, and AI-supported development environments.

As one of the world's leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we're committed to building an inclusive culture where innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning thrive.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Softwareingenieuren, Produktteams, Architekten, Qualitäts- und Regulierungsexperten helfen Sie dabei, Sicherheit in jede Phase des Produktentwicklungslebenszyklus zu integrieren. Anstatt sich auf die Betriebssicherheit zu konzentrieren, ermöglichen Sie Engineering-Teams, sichere Produkte durch Design zu entwickeln, Innovation, Usability, Compliance und Kundenvertrauen in Einklang zu bringen.

Wenn Sie einen starken Software-Engineering-Hintergrund haben und Ihre Expertise in Produkt-Cybersicherheit erweitert haben, ist dies eine Gelegenheit, Technologien zu gestalten, die das Leben von Millionen von Menschen weltweit verbessern.

Mehr über die Rolle

• Integrieren Sie Cybersicherheit im gesamten Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) für vernetzte medizinische Geräte, eingebettete Software, mobile Anwendungen und Cloud-Dienste.

• Führen Sie Bedrohungsmodellierungsaktivitäten, Cybersicherheitsrisikobewertungen und Minderungsplanung zusammen mit globalen F & E-Teams.

• Partnerschaft mit Software-Engineering-Teams, um Sicherheit in Entwicklungs-Workflows, DevSecOps-Praktiken und CI/CD-Pipelines einzubetten.

• Koordinieren Sie die Aktivitäten zum Management von Produktanfälligkeiten, einschließlich Bewertung, Priorisierung, Nachverfolgung von Mängeln und Überwachung nach dem Inverkehrbringen.

• Unterstützen Sie regulatorische Einreichungen und Qualitätsprozesse durch die Erstellung von Cybersicherheitsdokumentationen und -nachweisen.

• Beratung von Engineering-, Produktmanagement-, Qualitäts- und Regulierungsteams bei praktischen, risikobasierten Cybersicherheitsentscheidungen.

• Fördern Sie eine Security-First-Mentalität, indem Sie Teams coachen, Sicherheits-Champions unterstützen und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen in Forschung und Entwicklung vorantreiben.

Mehr über dich

Wesentliches

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informatik, Software Engineering, Engineering oder einer verwandten technischen Disziplin (oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung).

• 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in Software Engineering, Softwarearchitektur, Produktentwicklung, Secure SDLC oder einer vergleichbaren Softwareentwicklungsumgebung.

• Mindestens 3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Produktsicherheit oder Anwendungssicherheit.

• Ein fundiertes Verständnis von Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) und wie sich Cybersicherheit in die moderne Softwareentwicklung integriert.

• Erfahrung in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit Softwareentwicklungsteams während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus.

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Sicherheitsthemen sowohl technischen als auch nicht-technischen Stakeholdern zu erklären.

• Professionelle Arbeitskenntnisse in Englisch.

Nizza zu haben

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Software für Medizinprodukte oder andere regulierte Branchen.

• Erfahrung mit DevSecOps und Sicherheitsintegration in CI/CD-Pipelines.

• Kenntnis von Cybersicherheitsstandards und -vorschriften wie IEC 81001-5-1, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, MDR, FDA, DSGVO, CRA oder ähnlichen Frameworks.

• Sicherheitszertifizierungen wie CISSP, CSSLP, GIAC oder gleichwertige.

• Erfahrung mit Cloud-Sicherheit, Kryptographie, Authentifizierungstechnologien oder Software Supply Chain Security.

• Vertrautheit mit Privacy by Design-Prinzipien, Sicherheit von KI-Agenten und KI-unterstützten Entwicklungsumgebungen.

Mehr über das, was wir anbieten

Als einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Hörgeräten mit Hauptsitz in der Schweiz setzen wir uns für den Aufbau einer integrativen Kultur ein, in der Innovation, Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierliches Lernen gedeihen.

Der Beitritt zu Sonova bedeutet, mit hochqualifizierten internationalen Teams zusammenzuarbeiten, um Technologien zu entwickeln, die die Lebensqualität der Menschen wirklich verbessern. Wir bieten ein flexibles hybrides Arbeitsmodell, umfangreiche Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und klare Karrierewege, die sowohl Ihr berufliches als auch Ihr persönliches Wachstum unterstützen.

Hier haben Sie die Möglichkeit, sichere, vernetzte Gesundheitstechnologien zu gestalten, während Sie in einer Umgebung arbeiten, in der Ihre Ideen geschätzt werden und Ihre Auswirkungen sichtbar sind.

jobs.description:
Would you like to shape the architecture behind the next generation of charging solutions for hearing devices?

In this role, you will take technical ownership of the Charging Solutions domain, covering electronics, embedded software, mechanical interfaces and connectivity across the wider product ecosystem. You will define scalable platform architecture, guide development teams and suppliers, and turn complex requirements into robust, reusable solutions.

More about the role

• Take technical and architectural ownership of the Charging Solutions domain, guiding the development team, setting priorities and supporting effective delivery.

• Design charging architectures spanning electronics and embedded software, while ensuring effective integration with mechanical components.

• Define strategic, reusable platform elements and interfaces between chargers, hearing instruments, production software and application software.

• Translate customer, system and stakeholder needs into solutions that balance functionality, performance, quality, cost and long-term maintainability.

• Review electronic schematics, embedded software architecture and selected code, with hands-on programming representing approximately 10–20% of the role.

• Work closely with external suppliers, review their technical solutions and influence architectural decisions throughout the development chain.

• Make sound technical decisions in complex or uncertain situations and ensure compliance with medical-device, cybersecurity and privacy requirements.

• Document and communicate architectural decisions while promoting technical learning, best practices and continuous improvement across teams.

More about you

Must have

• A Master’s degree or equivalent in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems or a related technical discipline.

• At least five years of professional experience in hardware and/or embedded software development, including hands-on experience with charging solutions.

• Strong knowledge of electrical hardware and electronic schematics, combined with a solid understanding of embedded software architecture and the ability to review code.

• Experience designing complex hardware–software systems and managing dependencies across electronics, software, mechanics and connected applications.

• A pragmatic and decisive approach, with the ability to navigate uncertainty, evaluate technical trade-offs and drive solutions forward.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical groups and influence internal stakeholders and external suppliers.

• Strong communication and negotiation skills, together with professional fluency in English.

Nice to have

• Experience designing reusable platforms or modular product architectures.

• Experience working in a regulated environment, particularly in the medical-device industry.

• An architecture certification, such as iSAQB, or a PhD in a relevant technical field.

• Experience in technical leadership, agile development or technology assessment.

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

Application process

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your application via our online job application platform, including your CV and cover letter. For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered.

Vorresti modellare l'architettura dietro la nuova generazione di soluzioni di ricarica per apparecchi acustici?

In questo ruolo, prenderete la proprietà tecnica del dominio Charging Solutions, coprendo elettronica, software incorporato, interfacce meccaniche e connettività attraverso il più ampio ecosistema di prodotti. Definirai l'architettura scalabile della piattaforma, i team di sviluppo guida e i fornitori, e trasformerai i requisiti complessi in soluzioni robuste e riutilizzabili.

Ulteriori informazioni sul ruolo

• Prendere la proprietà tecnica e architettonica del dominio Charging Solutions, guidare il team di sviluppo, impostare le priorità e sostenere la consegna efficace.

• Architetture di ricarica per la progettazione che spaziano dall'elettronica e dal software incorporato, garantendo un'efficace integrazione con componenti meccanici.

• Definire elementi di piattaforma strategici e riutilizzabili e interfacce tra caricabatterie, strumenti acustici, software di produzione e software di applicazione.

• Tradurre il cliente, il sistema e le esigenze degli stakeholder in soluzioni che bilanciano funzionalità, prestazioni, qualità, costi e manutenbilità a lungo termine.

• Rivedere gli schemi elettronici, l'architettura software incorporata e il codice selezionato, con la programmazione hands-on che rappresenta circa il 10-20% del ruolo.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i fornitori esterni, rivedere le loro soluzioni tecniche e influenzare le decisioni architettoniche in tutta la catena di sviluppo.

• Prendere decisioni tecniche solide in situazioni complesse o incerte e garantire il rispetto dei requisiti medici-dispositivi, sicurezza informatica e privacy.

• Documentare e comunicare le decisioni architettoniche promuovendo l'apprendimento tecnico, le migliori pratiche e il miglioramento continuo delle squadre.

Più di te

Devo

• Laurea Magistrale o equivalente in ingegneria elettrica o elettronica, informatica, sistemi incorporati o una disciplina tecnica correlata.

• Almeno cinque anni di esperienza professionale nello sviluppo hardware e/o software integrato, tra cui esperienza pratica con soluzioni di ricarica.

• Forte conoscenza dell'hardware elettrico e degli schemi elettronici, combinato con una solida comprensione dell'architettura software incorporata e la capacità di rivedere il codice.

• Scopri la progettazione di sistemi hardware-software complessi e la gestione delle dipendenze tra elettronica, software, meccanica e applicazioni connesse.

• Un approccio pragmatico e decisivo, con la capacità di navigare in incertezza, valutare i trade-off tecnici e far avanzare soluzioni.

• Prove capacità di condurre gruppi tecnici interfunzionali e influenzare gli stakeholder interni e i fornitori esterni.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e di negoziazione, insieme alla fluidità professionale in inglese.

Che bello avere

• Esperienza nella progettazione di piattaforme riutilizzabili o architetture di prodotti modulari.

• Esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente regolamentato, in particolare nel settore medico-dispositivo.

• Una certificazione di architettura, come iSAQB, o un dottorato in un campo tecnico rilevante.

• Esperienza nella leadership tecnica, sviluppo agile o valutazione della tecnologia.

Maggiori informazioni su ciò che offriamo

Come uno dei principali fornitori di servizi per l’udito con sede in Svizzera, ci impegniamo a costruire una cultura inclusiva. Vogliamo creare un ambiente in cui è possibile bilanciare una carriera di successo con i vostri impegni e interessi al di fuori del lavoro, attraverso il nostro modello di lavoro ibrido flessibile. Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di formazione sia per il vostro sviluppo professionale che personale, e ci sono eccezionali opportunità di crescita con i piani di sviluppo individuali.

Processo di applicazione

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, non vede l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione tramite la nostra piattaforma di applicazione del lavoro online, compreso il vostro CV e lettera di copertura. Per questa vacanza, saranno considerate solo applicazioni dirette.

• Conception d'architectures de charge couvrant l'électronique et les logiciels embarqués, tout en assurant une intégration efficace avec les composants mécaniques.

jobs.description:
As a Hardware Verification Engineer - Charging Systems (m/f/d), you will play a key role in ensuring the performance, safety and reliability of our charging solutions for hearing devices.

You will combine hands-on electronics testing with Python-based test automation, developing test setups and verification methods that bring our products through development and towards market readiness. Working at the intersection of hardware, embedded software and system verification, you will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to turn complex technical requirements into robust, measurable and reliable solutions.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of verification activities throughout the product lifecycle while contributing directly to products that make a meaningful difference in people’s lives.

More about the role

• Design, build, calibrate and continuously improve test setups and measurement benches for the verification of charging solutions

• Develop and maintain automated verification frameworks and test scripts, with a strong focus on Python

• Plan and execute experiments to assess charging behavior, power management, performance and safety mechanisms under realistic usage conditions

• Translate system requirements, design specifications and risk analyses into effective test conditions, test cases and test procedures

• Investigate test failures, analyze measurement data, identify root causes and collaborate with development teams to drive corrective actions

• Process, visualize and document test and measurement data to provide clear evidence of product performance and verification results

• Collaborate closely with hardware, embedded software and system engineers as well as Test Managers, external partners and colleagues across different sites

More about you

• BSc or MSc degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field

• Around 3–6 years of experience in verification and testing of electronic systems, ideally combining hardware and embedded firmware

• Strong Python skills for test automation, data processing and analysis

• Hands-on experience developing custom test setups using Raspberry Pi, Arduino or similar MCU-based platforms, combined with solid electronics and measurement know-how

• Practical experience troubleshooting electronic devices and a structured approach to root-cause analysis and problem solving

• A proactive, quality-focused and collaborative mindset with the ability to work independently in an international, cross-functional environment

• Excellent English communication skills; German skills are an advantage

Experience with medical device development, C#, MATLAB, test management or relevant safety and regulatory standards is considered an advantage.

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

• Procéder, visualiser et documenter les données d'essai et de mesure pour fournir des preuves claires du rendement du produit et des résultats de vérification

• Collaborer étroitement avec les ingénieurs du matériel, des logiciels intégrés et du système ainsi qu'avec les gestionnaires de tests, les partenaires externes et les collègues de différents sites

Plus sur vous

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie électrique ou dans un domaine technique connexe

• Environ 3 à 6 ans d'expérience dans la vérification et l'essai de systèmes électroniques, combinant idéalement matériel et firmware embarqué

• Fortes compétences en Python pour l'automatisation des tests, le traitement et l'analyse des données
